properties.description:
Acceptance check for slice 3, to be written FAILING before it is built. Two designs: P (parent) and A (PART OF P). P sends req:p-r to A. In A it is a Requirement at proposed, with origin (design-p, req:p-r, P's version) and attributed to the sender. Any attempt to receive it at another status is refused. A's loop_status lists it as waiting. When A's owner accepts it, P's view of the allocation reads accepted. When P's req:p-r changes, A reports the origin moved. A ripple from P reaching its pin of A continues down seeded at the requirement A received, not with empty seeds.



ADDED 2026-10-07: the same check for a DECISION. P sends dec:p-d to A. It arrives at proposed with its origin. Once A's owner accepts it, an A requirement can be GOVERNED_BY A's copy. When P reopens dec:p-d, A reports the origin moved.
properties.name: A parent's requirement sent to its part arrives proposed with its origin, binds only on the part owner's word, and its moves are reported both ways
